FAQ.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Mdmak Tech
FAQ.q1: How does Mdmak Tech connect contractors with suppliers in Saudi Arabia?
FAQ.a1: Mdmak Tech is a B2B procurement platform where contractors post tenders and RFQs, and verified suppliers submit competitive quotes. The platform streamlines the entire sourcing process — from posting requirements to comparing offers and awarding contracts — all in one place.
FAQ.q2: Is Mdmak Tech free to use?
FAQ.a2: Yes, contractors and suppliers can register and start using the platform for free. The Starter plan includes up to 5 tenders per month with basic quotation features. For higher volumes and advanced features, we offer Pro and Enterprise plans.
FAQ.q3: What construction materials can I source through the platform?
FAQ.a3: You can request quotes for a wide range of construction materials including steel, cement, electrical supplies, paints, sanitary ware, HVAC systems, insulation, flooring, doors, and more. The platform supports all major categories used in Saudi construction projects.
FAQ.q4: How quickly do suppliers respond to RFQs?
FAQ.a4: Suppliers are notified instantly when a new tender is published. Response times vary, but most suppliers submit their offers within 24-48 hours. The platform sends automatic reminders as the deadline approaches to ensure competitive participation.
FAQ.q5: Can Mdmak Tech handle large-scale construction projects?
FAQ.a5: Absolutely. Mdmak Tech is built for projects of all sizes — from small renovations to large-scale commercial and infrastructure developments. The Enterprise plan includes ERP integration, dedicated account management, and advanced reporting for complex procurement needs.
FAQ.q6: How does Mdmak Tech ensure supplier quality?
FAQ.a6: All suppliers undergo a verification process including commercial registration (CR) and tax certificate validation. The platform also features a rating and review system where contractors rate suppliers after each completed order, building a transparent reputation system.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: Mdmak Tech is committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal and commercial data. This privacy policy has been prepared to explain how we collect, use, and protect your information in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Law in Saudi Arabia and global best practices.
Privacy.sec1_desc: When using the Mdmak Tech platform, we collect the following types of information:
Privacy.sec1_list_1: Basic Information: Name, email, job title, contact number, and Commercial Registration (CR).
Privacy.sec1_list_2: Company Data: Company information, commercial registration, procurement details, and tender data.
Privacy.sec1_list_3: Technical Data: IP address, browser type, and device information used to access the platform.
Privacy.sec2_desc: We use your data for the following purposes:
Privacy.sec2_list_1: To provide, operate, and maintain the Mdmak Tech platform to facilitate construction procurement.
Privacy.sec2_list_2: To improve user experience and develop new features that meet the needs of the contracting sector.
Privacy.sec2_list_3: To communicate with you regarding updates, security alerts, and technical support.
Privacy.sec2_list_4: To comply with legal and regulatory requirements in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
Privacy.sec3_desc_1: We do not sell your personal data to any third parties. Tender-related data is only shared between relevant parties (contractors and suppliers) based on the access permissions you set.
Privacy.sec3_desc_2: We use industry-leading encryption protocols (SSL/TLS) to protect your data during transmission and storage. Our servers are hosted in data centers that comply with local security requirements (e.g., National Cybersecurity Authority NCA).
Privacy.sec4_title: 4. Your Rights as a Data Subject
Privacy.sec4_desc: According to local regulations, you have the right to:
Privacy.sec4_list_1: Access and view your personal data.
Privacy.sec4_list_2: Request corrections or updates to your information.
Privacy.sec4_list_3: Request the deletion of your data (as permitted by commercial regulations).
Privacy.sec5_desc: If you have any questions about our privacy policy or how we process your data, please contact our privacy team at:
